name: daviddtechplus
description: DaviddTech+ in Claude Code, on top of the DaviddTech+ connector from claude.ai: ready routines as slash commands (after-close desk, night desk, storm check, watchlist triage, rule journal, DCA check-in, earnings week) and a market weather report with storm levels.

band.title: Market weather line
band.description: auto shows the storm levels of eight reference markets in the status line when a session starts (free, refreshed at most every 6 hours); command shows them only after /daviddtechplus-weather; off never shows them.
